trust_decision.summary: Whether a request-supplied plugin identifier (or the archive's mine.json name) may name a directory under plugin/ only; decided nowhere at the pinned commit; the fix adds normalizeIdentifier/assertSafeZipEntries in the app-store plugin's Service and a permission gate on its controller.

landing_point.why: Summary names identifier in install/uninstall; install() concatenates $params['identifier'] into the plugin path and passes it to Plugin::install.

fix_sites.module_kind: plugin service (same file as landing point)
plugin service; identifier comes from uploaded archive's mine.json, plus zip entry names/symlinks (zip-slip)
controller authorization (PermissionMiddleware + Permission plugin:store added, fix.diff:27-28)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changed sites are in plugin/mine-admin/app-store/src/Service/Service.php; the real filesystem sinks (Mine\AppStore\Plugin::install/uninstall, AppStoreServiceImpl::download) live in vendor package mineadmin/app-store (composer.json:60), not in this repository.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: uploadLocalApp takes no 'identifier' parameter; a solver may argue the archive is trusted admin-supplied content, so neither $json['name'] (Service.php:123) nor the zip entry names/symlinks need checks.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate vendor/name identifiers such as 'mine-admin/app-store' (one slash, hyphens) must still install/uninstall/upload; over-broad fixes that reject '/' or basename() the identifier break every plugin, and rejecting all zip subdirectories breaks normal archives.

O6_input_shapes: '..' segments / extra slashes in identifier (regex vendor/name only)
identifier taken from uploaded archive's mine.json name
zip entry names with '..' segments, absolute '/' paths, backslashes, Windows drive letters, NUL bytes
zip entries that are Unix symlinks

O7_producer.where: Closest analogue: uploaded archive's mine.json decoded at plugin/mine-admin/app-store/src/Service/Service.php:117-123 supplies the directory name; not a separate producer module.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An identifier-taking 'local app info' / 'upgrade' method that reads plugin/<identifier>/mine.json via Plugin::read, next to getLocalAppInstallList.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getLocalAppInstallList already calls Plugin::read on relative paths; a per-plugin detail/update endpoint is a natural maintainer addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: detail route falling back to reading a locally installed plugin's README/mine.json under plugin/<identifier> when offline.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: detail already forwards request identifier unvalidated; a local fallback is plausible for offline installs.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second archive importer (e.g. install-from-URL or tar.gz) with its own extraction loop in another class.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Gives a real second implementation at distance for the zip-entry check, which the current code lacks.

O9_family: path traversal (CWE-22) in plugin identifier and archive extraction (zip-slip), plus missing function-level authorization on the store controller

O10_build.project_tests: None for app-store; tests/ only references Plugin::init in tests/bootstrap.php:37. download route needs the remote store, install/unInstall/uploadLocalApp can be exercised offline (Service unit-level with a temp plugin dir).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject '..' in $params['identifier'] in install/unInstall only, leaving array input, download, and uploadLocalApp's mine.json name and zip entries open.

out_of_scope_notes: Sinks Mine\AppStore\Plugin::install/uninstall and AppStoreServiceImpl::download/view are in vendor package mineadmin/app-store (composer.json:60), not in this tree; any CLI commands in that package reaching them are outside this repository.
